protocol.world: Original flat city floor/contact material only; city obstacles removed for this isolated numerical fixture. The application city is unchanged.
protocol.initial: 2 s physical rest settling at [-320,0.62,0], then one declared forward rolling state v=target and wheel omega=v/r. No measured state assignments.
protocol.steering: Fixed road-wheel centre 2 deg at 54 km/h and 0.8 deg at 90 km/h; steeringAssist=false, ABS/TCS=true. This is not a keyboard turn or a test of the speed-sensitive steering map.
protocol.longitudinal: Same PI ordinary-pedal driver: ground-plane speed feedback, Kp=1.6, Ki=0.6, integral +/-6; drag+rolling feed-forward. Uses actual throttle/brake, without assigning velocity.

limitations: Numerical sustained-turn regression, not real keyboard/camera feel, rendered pixels, GPU performance or Tesla calibration.
The fixed final 5 s window is evaluated without searching for a favorable interval; failure remains a failure.
A stable circular arc does not imply a complete lap. Radius is fitted to actual last-window trajectory and also reported from speed/yaw.

All physical parameters stay at their declared version defaults except the explicit identical road/supply/steering protocol. Both models use the same dry mu=1.25, wet multiplier=0.52, 700 kW motor ceiling and 600 L bench mass.
